transaction_rule: Each migration plus existing-ledger journal entry commits atomically; no internal COMMIT
preflight: Verify agreements, agreement_templates, applications, documents, private.is_staff/private.is_manager and esign_claim baseline
Refuse duplicate legacy template versions; never rewrite template or signed history to satisfy indexes
Verify existing agreements policy definition if present
Verify current journal/receipt and assign actual execution-order timestamps
staging: Existing reduced staging previously lacked agreements. Approve installation of the real existing eSign baseline separately; never create placeholder tables or replay the entire repository blindly
